integrity: The infinite statement is proved by explicit constructions and a parity contradiction. Finite enumeration is used only as a consistency check. The two directly relevant recent papers and the MSC2020 classification entry were materially inspected; no independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The theorem classifies only witness-free sets of size \(n+3\) that contain every odd integer in \(\{1,\ldots,2n\}\). It does not classify all extremal sets, and no claim is made for \(n<6\).
title: Uniqueness of the parity-saturated four-sum extremizer
